name: conversation-memory
description: Saves every conversation to a per-project SQLite memory and lets Claude search it

cliPath.title: Memory core CLI
cliPath.description: Path to dist/cli.js of mod-db-conversation. Leave empty to use the one in this repository

nodePath.title: Node.js
nodePath.description: The node executable that runs the CLI

storage.title: Storage mode
storage.description: shared: one DB for every project in ~/.claude-memory, separated by project id. repo: a DB in each repository's .claude/conversation-memory, and a session reads only its own repository's DB

autoContext.title: Attach related past conversations
autoContext.description: On each prompt, attach up to 3 closely related excerpts from earlier conversations of this project
